entities.name: Alphabet Paid Click Growth 2Q25
entities.brief: Paid click growth accelerated in Q2 2025
entities.description: Alphabet's paid click growth accelerated 2pts quarter-over-quarter to 4% year-over-year in Q2 2025, from 2% in Q1.

entities.name: Alphabet YouTube Shorts Revenue Parity US 2Q25
entities.brief: YouTube Shorts ad revenue per hour parity in US
entities.description: YouTube Shorts now deliver the same ad revenue per hour as traditional in-stream ads in the US, as of Q2 2025.

entities.name: Alphabet ex-FX Search Growth 2Q25
entities.brief: Ex-FX Search revenue growth decelerated in Q2 2025
entities.description: Ex-FX Search growth decelerated 1pt quarter-over-quarter to 11% year-over-year in Q2 2025, from 12% in Q1 2025.

entities.name: Alphabet Capex Estimate 2025
entities.description: Alphabet's 2025 Capex estimate raised to $86bn from $76bn.

entities.name: Alphabet Free Cash Flow Estimate 2025
entities.description: Alphabet's 2025 FCF estimate reduced to $62bn from $71bn.

entities.name: Alphabet Depreciation and Amortization Growth 2Q25
entities.description: Depreciation & Amortization year-over-year growth accelerated to 35% in Q2 2025 from 31% in Q1, expected to further accelerate in Q3.

entities.name: Alphabet Negative Catalysts Event Aug 2025
entities.brief: Potential negative catalysts for Alphabet in Aug 2025
entities.description: Event risk for Alphabet in Aug 2025 including OpenAI ads/browser, Meta new products, DoJ search case remedy ruling.

entities.name: Alphabet YouTube Revenue 2Q25
entities.description: YouTube revenues grew 13% y/y in Q2 2025, beating Street's 11% estimate, with an 8pt easier comp.

entities.name: Meta Advertising Revenue 2Q25
entities.brief: Meta advertising revenue estimate for Q2 2025
entities.description: Meta's Q2 2025 advertising revenue estimated at $44.5bn (up 16% y/y); Street at $43.7bn.

entities.name: Meta Revenue Guidance Upper End 2Q25
entities.description: Meta could report at or above upper end of 2Q guidance ($45.5bn); 3Q guidance upper end expected $1bn higher.

entities.name: Alphabet Network Revenue 2Q25
entities.description: Google network revenue was $7.4bn (vs Street $7.2bn); growth accelerated by 1pt to down 1% y/y.

entities.name: Alphabet YouTube Revenue Beat 2Q25
entities.description: YouTube revenue was $9.8bn (vs Street $9.5bn) in Q2 2025.

entities.name: Alphabet YouTube ex-FX Growth 2Q25
entities.brief: YouTube ex-FX revenue growth stable in Q2 2025
entities.description: YouTube ex-FX growth stable at around 12% in Q2 2025.

entities.name: Pinterest Revenue 2Q25
entities.description: Pinterest 2Q25 estimated revenue $980mn (vs Street $974mn), up 15% y/y, decelerating 1pt q/q. Street y/y: 14%

entities.name: Snap Ad Revenue 2Q25
entities.description: Snap Q2 2025 ad revenue expected at $1,162mn (vs Street $1,186mn), 3% y/y, down 6pts q/q.
